name: Direct for Travel & Tourism
note: Saudi travel and tourism company (visa services, bookings; directksa.com). Al-Shabab announced 'دايركت (DIRECTKSA)' as a club sponsor on 2025-08-28 (club Facebook post, https://www.facebook.com/AlshababSaudiFC/posts/1381385266880595). The iOS app's publisher is listed as AL-MUSAFIR AL-MABASHIR COMPANY FOR TRAVEL AND TOURISM (Apple App Store), and the company's LinkedIn page names Mohammed Aldhali as founder and CEO. Who owns the company is not sourced, so the sponsor stays not rated yet. Not on the 2026-27 kit record: the sleeve placement for 2026-27 is not confirmed by any text source, and the sleeve sponsor mark in the SPL kit photo could not be identified with confidence.
